{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "LB_fill_and_inoculate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_1000ul", 1)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_1_reservoir_195ml", 2)
    glycerol_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 3)
    deep_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_2ml_deep", 4)
    p1000 = protocol.load_instrument("p1000_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])

    # Define liquids
    lb = protocol.define_liquid(name="lb", description="LB medium", display_color="#0000FF")
    glycerol_stock = protocol.define_liquid(name="glycerol_stock", description="Glycerol stock", display_color="#00FF00")

    # Load liquids
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=lb, volume=48000)
    for well in glycerol_plate.wells():
        glycerol_plate[well.name].load_liquid(liquid=glycerol_stock, volume=100)

    # Fill deep well plate and inoculate
    for well in deep_plate.wells():
        well_name = well.name
        p1000.pick_up_tip()
        p1000.aspirate(500, reservoir["A1"])
        p1000.dispense(500, deep_plate[well_name])
        p1000.aspirate(5, glycerol_plate[well_name])
        p1000.dispense(5, deep_plate[well_name])
        p1000.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "LB_fill_and_inoculate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips_1000 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_1000ul", 1)
    tips_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 2)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_1_reservoir_195ml", 3)
    glycerol_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 4)
    deep_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_2ml_deep", 5)
    p1000 = protocol.load_instrument("p1000_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips_1000])
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tips_20])

    # Define liquids
    lb = protocol.define_liquid(name="lb", description="LB medium", display_color="#0000FF")
    glycerol_stock = protocol.define_liquid(name="glycerol_stock", description="Glycerol stock", display_color="#00FF00")

    # Load liquids
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=lb, volume=48000)
    for row in "ABCDEFGHIJ"[:8]:  # rows A-H
        for col in range(1,13):  # columns 1-12
            well_name = row + str(col)
            glycerol_plate[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=glycerol_stock, volume=100)

    # Fill deep well plate and inoculate
    for row in "ABCDEFGHIJ"[:8]:  # rows A-H
        for col in range(1,13):  # columns 1-12
            well_name = row + str(col)
            # Transfer 500 ul LB
            p1000.pick_up_tip()
            p1000.aspirate(500, reservoir["A1"])
            p1000.dispense(500, deep_plate[well_name])
            p1000.drop_tip()
            # Transfer 5 ul glycerol stock with mixing
            p20.pick_up_tip()
            p20.aspirate(5, glycerol_plate[well_name])
            p20.dispense(5, deep_plate[well_name], mix_after=(5, 404))
            p20.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "LB_fill_and_inoculate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips_1000 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_1000ul", 1)
    tips_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 2)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_1_reservoir_195ml", 3)
    glycerol_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 4)
    deep_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_2ml_deep", 5)
    p1000 = protocol.load_instrument("p1000_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips_1000])
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tips_20])

    # Define liquids
    lb = protocol.define_liquid(name="lb", description="LB medium", display_color="#0000FF")
    glycerol_stock = protocol.define_liquid(name="glycerol_stock", description="Glycerol stock", display_color="#00FF00")

    # Load liquids
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=lb, volume=48000)
    for row in "ABCDEFGHIJ"[:8]:  # rows A-H
        for col in range(1,13):  # columns 1-12
            well_name = row + str(col)
            glycerol_plate[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=glycerol_stock, volume=100)

    # Fill deep well plate and inoculate
    for row in "ABCDEFGHIJ"[:8]:  # rows A-H
        for col in range(1,13):  # columns 1-12
            well_name = row + str(col)
            # Transfer 500 ul LB
            p1000.pick_up_tip()
            p1000.aspirate(500, reservoir["A1"])
            p1000.dispense(500, deep_plate[well_name])
            p1000.drop_tip()
            # Transfer 5 ul glycerol stock with mixing
            p20.pick_up_tip()
            p20.aspirate(5, glycerol_plate[well_name])
            p20.dispense(5, deep_plate[well_name])
            p20.mix(404, 5, deep_plate[well_name])
            p20.drop_tip()"}

protocol.py: 1 biology problem (1 warning).

1. WARNING MIX-TOO-WEAK: A pipette too small to mix 94 wells: 20 ul at most in 505 ul
   line 39:  p20.mix(404, 5, deep_plate[well_name])
   At line 39 the tip mixes wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 86 more in slot 5 with
   404 strokes of 5 ul in a well holding 505 ul (this line did it 94 times). The P20 can
   draw at most 20 ul, under a fifth of the well: no stroke it can make will mix this well,
   however many times. Integra draws over 80% of the well five times; three mixes gave 11.8%
   CV where twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not at the concentration you
   calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits the error.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 86 more in slot 5.
   Fix: Mix with a bigger pipette (a P300 for this well): at least 5 strokes of 300 ul,
   `mix(5, 300, well)`.
